usage: cox host [-h] [--profile PROFILE]
                {add,list,drain,remove,activate,capacity,beat,doctor,sync} ...

The hosts table: lane hosts, their capacity, versions and login.

positional arguments:
  {add,list,drain,remove,activate,capacity,beat,doctor,sync}
    add                 add or update a host in the table
    list                one line per host: state, capacity, beat age, login
    drain               stop launching on a host; its live lanes finish
    remove              delete a drained idle host from the hosts table
    activate            make a host a lane host again
    capacity            change only a host's capacity, leaving ssh, weight and capabilities as
                        they are
    beat                record this machine's versions and claude login in the table
    doctor              the table's line for a host, then its doctor over ssh
    sync                git pull --ff-only in the harness, cartridges and tools checkouts on a
                        host

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE

examples:
  cox host add jarvis --ssh jarvis --capacity 8
  cox host list
  cox host beat
  cox host sync jarvis
